description_en: Queries the list of metadata discovery task instances
description_zh: 查询元数据发现任务实例列表
kebab_example: aliyun adb query-formation-insts-by-task-id --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-id 123 --db-cluster-id am-bp1r053byu48p0000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryFormationInstsByTaskID

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html to query available region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域id，您可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html查看可用的地域id
parameters.name: region_id

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates success

items.description_en: Deprecated. For more information, see Items

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created

LastTaskInstCostTime.description_en: The execution duration of the most recent task
LastTaskInstCostTime.description_zh: 最近一次任务的执行时间

LastTaskInstID.description_en: The instance ID of the most recent task

LastTaskInstMessage.description_en: The error message of the most recent task
LastTaskInstMessage.description_zh: 最近一次任务的错误信息

LastTaskInstState.description_en: The instance status of the most recent node
LastTaskInstState.description_zh: 最近一次任务实例状态

Schema.description_en: The schema ID assigned to the instance by the system

SourceType.description_en:
The task source. Valid values:
system: system.
custom: custom
SourceType.description_zh: 任务来源，取值如下：-system：系统。-custom：自定义

SyncTime.description_en: The synchronization time, accurate to milliseconds. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
SyncTime.description_zh: 同步时间，精确到毫秒，格式：yyyy-mm-ddthh:mm:ssz
